name: product-hero
prompt: Premium Mauvelle luxury period-comfort brand campaign. Photorealistic medium-format product photography, tangible fine paper/fabric texture, authentic optical shadows, sophisticated beauty editorial art direction. Colors: matte lavender #B9A6D9, warm cream #F7F1EA, plum #3E2A4F, no pink. Consistent soft natural window light from upper left, subtle film grain, natural materials. This must look photographed, never a flat illustration or cheap plastic 3D render. No UI, collages, diagrams, watermark, decorative flowers or extra labels. Use the supplied images ONLY as packaging design and exact crescent-wordmark references, not as composition. Create a 1536x1024 landscape still-life photograph: one assembled upright slim rectangular lavender folding carton, one individually sealed lavender crimp-edge flexible foil sachet leaning against it, and one cream rounded-rectangle nonwoven heat patch lying in the foreground on a warm ivory stone surface. Box approximately 16cm tall, sachet about 13cm tall, patch 11cm by 8cm with softly quilted shallow rectangular cells. The box is at a three-quarter angle and the front design follows the reference: small 'SOOTHING HEAT PATCHES', supplied crescent above supplied lowercase 'mauvelle' wordmark, small italic 'Soothing warmth, beautifully kept.' The sachet has that same supplied crescent-wordmark and only '1 heat patch'. IMPORTANT omit the 8h badge, duration claims, count claims, drug-free and all other unconfirmed claims from reference. No apricot badge. Keep the exact brand logo structure. The patch is unprinted, ivory textured fabric, with subtle rounded welded edge, not plastic. Compose centrally with products occupying 70 percent of frame and comfortable margins. Warm cream linen folds touch the lower left foreground, a pale lavender seamless wall background. Strong but soft directional light, very realistic luxury e-commerce photo. No people.
